annotations.text: Option A. Editorial. A masthead, a proof-stat strip, and a numbered work index; each aspect carries weight and a kind tag. The calmest of the three, reading as a writer-architect.

Option B. Panels. A modular grid where every aspect is its own bordered panel: Protean with the live runner, a metric, a compact timeline. The most structured; kept restrained so it stays a hub, not a dashboard.
Option C. System. Dark and mono-forward, a builder's console, with the Protean runner front and centre. The strongest aesthetic commitment, most on-theme for AI-native, least warm.
